done_when: The story template has a '## New and existing repos' section above Risks, saying what a fresh init or adoption gets, what an existing repo gets on upgrade, and naming a test for each; the cold read reports a story whose section is missing or covers only one side; the review instructions check the upgrade path of an existing repo; the fix brief and skill say a fix states both sides in one line. One command-level test: a cold read of a story without the section reports it.
why: Features get planned and reviewed for Forge's own repo or a fresh init only, so existing client repos on older Forge versions get skipped or broken on upgrade
